articles.title: BNB Chain is building a new layer-1 for high-frequency trading and AI agents
articles.snippet: The network aims to process over 100,000 transactions per second by streaming them directly, eliminating public queues to make trades faster and more secure.

articles.title: SpaceX's first bitcoin wallet movements in six months likely don't signal sales
articles.snippet: Onchain trackers found the newly public company shifted a tiny amount of bitcoin between its own addresses. Nothing reached an exchange.

articles.title: BlackRock-backed Securitize slides 40% after SPAC debut despite tokenization boom
articles.snippet: The decline fits into a pattern of recently-public digital asset companies sliding after debut, Arca's Jeff Dorman said.

articles.title: SEC's Long-Promised Crypto Safe Harbor to Be Introduced as Soon as This Month
articles.snippet: The SEC updated its agenda to indicate that a key crypto rulemaking is slated to be released for public comment in July.

articles.title: BIG3 NFT Buyers Sue Ice Cube's Basketball League Over Alleged Unfulfilled Promises
articles.snippet: Investors who purchased BIG3 NFTs expected the perks of team ownership, but allege "deceptive, fraudulent" marketing was at play.
